title: 3rd Annual Roger Murray Lecture
summary: The speakers argue that the recent market correction is driven by a combination of lingering post-pandemic growth deceleration, a shift in Federal Reserve policy regarding inflation, and a significant rise in real interest rates which has increased the expected equity risk premium to over 7% real. They further suggest that this environment creates a challenging landscape where investors must identify companies with sufficient pricing power to overcome inflation and navigate the volatility caused by noisy economic signals.
